feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 14 September 2026 10:16pm
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Monday, 14 September 2026 at 10:15pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds.


##Synopsis##

Complex low pressure near Iceland, moving southeast, with associated frontal troughs crossing the British Isles.


##Wind##

Mainly southwest 5 or 6, veering west overnight, decreasing Tuesday morning to 4 or 5 but still occasionally 6 in places. Veering late afternoon & evening to mainly northwest 4 or 5, but 5 or 6 for a while in the area from near the north of the Isle of Man to Morecambe Bay.


##State of Sea##

Mainly moderate at first, becoming slight or moderate overnight.


##Weather##

Periods of rain, becoming mainly fair overnight.


##Visibility##

Moderate or good, occasionally poor in places at first tonight, becoming mainly good overnight.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

Northwest 4 or 5, backing west 3 or 4 by Wednesday afternoon, then southwest 4 or 5 by early evening, increasing 5 or 6 later.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate, becoming mostly slight for a while Wednesday afternoon.


##Weather##

Showers, becoming mostly fair, then rain spreading from the west later on Wednesday evening.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate in showers, becoming mostly moderate in the rain later on Wednesday evening.
